title: Velvety Festive Greek Lamb Gyro
description: A twist on traditional Greek lamb gyro, featuring the sweetness of peach juice and the richness of render-fat, all in a festive tagine pot serving.

ingredients.name: Greek lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: Bone-in or boneless works, about 2 lbs.

instructions:
Preheat your oven to 3004F (150C).
Season the lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, and oregano. Rub well to coat.
Sear the lamb in a skillet with a little fat over medium-high heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. 
Transfer the lamb to a tagine pot or Dutch oven and add sliced onion, minced garlic, and rendered fat. Stir to coat.
Cover the tagine pot and transfer it to the preheated oven for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and easily shreds.
Meanwhile, toast some pita bread in the oven until lightly browned. 
To assemble the gyros, slice the lamb into thin strips and serve with toasted pita, yogurt sauce, cucumber, olives, and parsley.
To make the yogurt sauce, mix together Greek yogurt, peach juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl until combined.
Taste and adjust the sauce as needed.
Serve the gyros hot, garnished with a sprig of parsley and a dollop of yogurt sauce.
Serve immediately and enjoy!
